description: Check colors for print. Pass `colors` as lines: hex (#1a2b3c), rgb(26,43,60), cmyk(60,40,40,100) or C=60 M=40 Y=40 K=100, or a spot name (Pantone, HKS, RAL and so on). Optionally `stock` (coated, uncoated, newsprint) for the total area coverage (TAC, sum of the four ink percentages) limit, and `smallest_text_pt` for the smallest black text. Reports the mode of each line, naive CMYK for RGB (no color management), TAC against the limit (conventions: about 300 coated, 260 uncoated, 240 newsprint; the printer's figure wins), rich black versus flat K, 400% registration black, near-pure-RGB colors likely to fall outside the CMYK gamut, spot colors that add a plate, and overprint notes.
name: check_colour_mode
title: Color mode check
